title: Model magic item random-procedure devices (M8)
description: Implement family M8 from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §4: 18 rows. Flagships: deck-of-many-things (declared-draw procedure, 1-hour inter-draw limit, card resolution incl. XP/level/alignment/soul-trap outcomes) and wand-of-wonder (d100 procedure with range/centering/random-subject meta-rules). Also: deck-of-illusions (deck missing 1d20-1 cards), bag-of-beans, efreeti-bottle, amulet-of-the-planes (d100 mishap INLINE in prose — evaluate extracting a table record via importer per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md), helm-of-brilliance explosion roll, horn-of-blasting 20%, wind-fan cumulative 20%, staff-of-power/staff-of-the-magi retributive strike, sword-of-sharpness nested d20, figurine obsidian 10%, random found-state rows (iron-flask, ring-of-spell-storing, necklace-of-prayer-beads, robe-of-useful-items). Shape: seeded-roll procedure + tableRef binding + percent-risk clauses. All randomness through the seeded roll tool. Recommended agent: Opus 4.8 for procedure representation; Codex for simple percent-risk rows.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: Random-procedure devices should expose seeded-roll/table/procedure semantics in the pack and route all randomness through the roll tool/F1 surface. Irregular card/device outcomes may be curated specs when source-grounded and parity-checked; live persistent outcomes must be runtime state or explicit engine hooks.
Implemented the source-grounded family projector, strict schema validation, clause registry bindings, generated pack projection, and representative/exhaustive tests. The exact 240-row owner-tag conservation census passes; all magic items now carry reviewed executable mechanics.
close_reason: Source-faithful executable magic-item family complete; canonical regeneration, conservation gates, deep audit, and full worktree verification pass.
